messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content: 抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的網球排名。若您需要最新資訊，建議查看官方 ATP（男子）或 WTA（女子）網站、或使用專門的體育數據 API。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？" (Who is currently ranked number one tennis player?). We need to retrieve current ranking. Use function sports_team_standing? That function is for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual ranking. We might need to answer based on knowledge. But we don't have real-time data. We can say we don't have up-to-date info. But maybe we can approximate: As of 2023, men's top is Novak Djokovic, women's top is Iga Swiatek. But current? We can't guarantee. We can say we don't have real-time data. So we should respond that we cannot fetch current ranking. We can provide approximate. But better to say we don't have real-time data.
